commands.set_freq: expected_value is integer kHz, 400000..900000; retains existing hardware/profile/planning gate upstream

identity.target: exact trusted receiver/device identity + CH + socket peer + pairing session + registered brand
identity.group: display only; trusted GROUP ascending, same group CH ascending, unknown last
identity.browser: exact HTTPS Origin, server assigned ctl-<32 hex>; no credentials, no user-selected reply topic
identity.receiver: existing daty-pairing-v1 and fashe-realtime-v1 command_id status receipt; no telemetry-only ACK downgrade

deduplication.request_id: durable correlation uniqueness; different operation/digest/entry is a conflict
deduplication.operation_id: durable global intent uniqueness within this server ledger, across UI sessions and restarts
deduplication.digest: canonical JSON of server_id, boot_id, deadline_at_ms and complete body
deduplication.command_id: server generated once, never supplied by requester
deduplication.singleEntry: one configured active entry; MQTT mode rejects both new HTTPS mutation and old /api/command; original direct sender is disabled in isolated Bridge
deduplication.controllerLease: Windows OS byte-range lock; one live controller per journal, automatically released on process death
deduplication.commit: SQLite WAL + synchronous FULL before reserve/dispatch decision; uncertain commit fences further dispatch
deduplication.restart: reserved/dispatching/published recover to unknown; no resume queue, no retry
deduplication.scope: at most one server dispatch attempt per operation; not exactly-once hardware execution

receipt.mqttPuback: Broker receipt only; not accepted business decision, device execution or durable commit
receipt.published: socket send completed; does not mean receiver execution
receipt.acknowledged: matching paired current receiver/session, command_id, device/CH, brand and exact actual value, durably recorded
receipt.timeoutOrUnknown: may already have executed; query only, no automatic resend, HTTP fallback, optimistic success or inferred cancellation
receipt.lateOrWrongAck: never promotes terminal timeout/unknown; wrong session/ID/channel/brand/value ignored
receipt.targetFence: pending, timeout or unknown blocks another operation on the target until a separately reviewed reconciliation mechanism is implemented
